T: Ming is merciless. Dinner is not.
D: A football star crash lands on the planet Mongo and takes on Ming the Merciless.
P: Serve the snacks when Flash starts the football brawl in Ming's palace.
S: Flash fighting the guards with a football game
Chicken thigh pieces crumbed and fried, shaped like little footballs, with a honey mustard dip.
Prince Barin's forest moon of Arboria
Button mushrooms stuffed with garlic butter, breadcrumbs and parsley, baked at 200C for 12 minutes until golden.
Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a sticky honey, soy and chilli glaze, scattered with sesame.
M: Beef eye fillet roasted to medium-rare, sliced on a long platter with roasted red onions, beetroot and a rich red wine sauce.
Chicken thighs in a hot red curry with coconut milk, capsicum and Thai basil, served with jasmine rice.
W: Ming's red and gold palace on Mongo
Sponge layered with raspberry jelly, mango, custard and whipped cream, chilled overnight and topped with gold sprinkles.
K: Princess Aura and her red palace
Pomegranate and cranberry juice with soda water and fresh lime over ice in tall glasses.

s.note: Flash fighting the guards with a football game
s.how: Cut 600g chicken thighs into chunks and press into small oval shapes. Coat in flour, beaten egg and panko breadcrumbs. Shallow fry until golden and cooked through. Mix honey with Dijon mustard for a dipping sauce and serve the footballs piled on a platter.

Toss 1kg chicken wings with salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Warm 3 tbsp honey with 3 tbsp soy sauce and a sliced red chilli until sticky. Toss the wings through the glaze and scatter with toasted sesame seeds before serving.

m.how: Fry 2 tbsp red curry paste in a little oil until fragrant. Add 600g sliced chicken thighs and brown, then pour in 400ml coconut milk and simmer 15 minutes. Add a sliced red capsicum for the last 5 minutes, stir through Thai basil and serve with jasmine rice.

w.note: Ming's red and gold palace on Mongo
w.how: Cut a sponge cake into cubes and press into a glass bowl. Make up raspberry jelly, pour over the sponge and chill until set. Layer with sliced mango, 500ml custard and whipped cream. Chill overnight and finish with gold sprinkles just before serving.

d.note: Princess Aura and her red palace
d.how: Fill tall glasses with ice. Pour in equal parts pomegranate juice and cranberry juice to about halfway. Top with cold soda water and squeeze in a wedge of lime. Stir once and serve straight away while it is deep red and fizzing.
